Name: Shared Exp
Author: batzpup
TagLine:
All experience is shared across multiplayer.
E.g player 1 mines a rock all players get 3 mining exp.
Requires all players that want to share exp to have this installed
Description:
Syncs up experience gains across all players.
When a new player connects their skills experience values are set to match everyone on the servers so they don't miss out.

*   Now works with 1.6

*   Now supports mastery.
Has option to split exp as opposed to 'duplicating' exp (Off by default)
Has the option to allow catchup exp, when a new players join it boosts their exp up to everyone else's (On by default)

Currently Supports vanilla luck as an extra skill. (Opt in)

Currently Supported mods:

*   Hardew Valley - Slow Life In The Valley

*   Skills made with SpaceCore

*   Supports Mastery Extended's custom EXP distrubution post lvl 10

Manifest.Name: SharedXp
Manifest.Description: Shares skill xp among all players in multiplayer
